## Contracts, consumers, and exclusions
Preserve the closed typed-mutation registry; marker-safe comment fitting and persistent comment identity; authoritative absence/direct-GET handling; per-project map memoization; canonical field arbitration, parent clears, and managed link removal; create/update payload contracts; differ/apply/persist phase order; nonfatal status preflight; baseline and peer-confirmation evidence; scoped store commits and truthful tallies; composed backend/runtime scope; and lag-free primary-store refresh. Reconciler callers, compatibility re-exports, and the unit contract suite are the consumers; no selected docstring is read through __doc__ or inspect.getdoc in the pinned tree.

Concise/load-bearing prose outside the allowlist stays byte-identical. So do runtime strings, assertions, fixtures, decorators, subprocess arguments, config values, and all 39 directive/shebang physical lines. All files are Python.

## Verification and independent review
Parse base/final Python with `type_comments=True`; replace only allowlisted owner docstrings, normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`, and require the remaining AST/runtime tree to match. A zero-context hunk guard confines deletions/insertions to allowlisted base spans. Run all six structured DD commands, including untimed worktree-venv `make verify`.

A reviewer who did not author the patch records a leaf-linked TSV with exactly 198 PASS rows, one per stable ID: `stable_id,before_citation,final_citation,preserved_contract_or_consumer,directives_exact,before_words,final_words,reviewer_session,semantic_pass,bloat_pass`. Every `final_words` is smaller; missing, extra, duplicate, or FAIL rows block closure.
